label: Kerosene
source: Fossil Jet A-1. LHV standard; CO2 factor Al-Timimi (3.16); price at dispenser Hoelzen et al. 2025; refuel flow/plug times Al-Timimi

label: LH₂
source: Green LH2. LHV standard; zero tank-to-wake CO2; price mid of 2-3 USD/kg at main European airports 2050 (Hoelzen et al. 2025); refuel Al-Timimi

label: Fossil LNG
source: Fossil liquefied methane (default methane). LHV standard; CO2 from CH4 stoichiometry (44/16); price = LNG Japan 10.5 USD/mmbtu 2027f (World Bank CMO Oct 2025) = 0.50 USD/kg + airport handling 6.5 EURct/kg (Raab et al. 2024); refuel data: gap

label: e-methane
source: Synthetic methane (switch: aircraft_overrides CH4-NB fuel ch4_e). CO2 burnt 2.75 kg/kg is taken from the air when made (well-to-tank -2.75, placeholder: ignores production energy) and zero-rated for the carbon price (EU ETS treats eligible e-fuels as zero-emission); price = LH2 price x Raab et al. 2024 e-LCH4/e-LH2 ratio (220/157 per MWh)
